title: Relationships and messages — in sentences
summary: Use the English meaning as well as the Swedish context to choose or type the missing word or phrase. Practise relationships, compliments and replies. Att introduces a statement clause. Swedish adjective endings still agree with gender and number.

s01.sentenceGloss: She says that she is happy.

s02.sentenceGloss: I know that she does not want to come.

s03.sentenceGloss: He is in love with his friend.
s03.note: Vara kär i: be in love with.

s04.sentenceGloss: They no longer want to be together; they break up.

s05.sentenceGloss: What a nice jumper! – Thank you!

s06.sentenceGloss: What a lovely house you have!

s08.sentenceGloss: We are talking about gender equality.
